label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

expected_schema.description: Verifiable Random result and complete drand derivation transcript.

algorithm_version.description: Pinned canonicalization, derivation, and sampling algorithm version required to reproduce the result.

beacon.description: Locally verified drand Quicknet proof used as the public randomness source.

chain_hash.description: Pinned Quicknet chain hash used to fetch and verify the round.

randomness.description: Lowercase hexadecimal randomness derived from the verified signature.

round.description: Exact verified Quicknet round used for this result.

scheduled_time.description: Scheduled UTC publication time of the selected round.

signature.description: Lowercase hexadecimal BLS signature verified against the pinned Quicknet public key.

example_only.description: True only in compiled catalog/keepalive examples; live paid results are false.

operation.description: Random operation performed by this route.

processed_at.description: UTC time when the service accepted the request and committed to the round-selection decision.

request_hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of your canonical request JSON — retain the exact request body so you can re-derive the result offline.

result.description: Operation-specific result derived deterministically from the verified beacon and request hash.

original_indices.description: For each selected value, its zero-based position in the input array.

selection_mode.description: server_next means the server chose the next safe unpublished round, so you trust its selection chronology; client_fixed means the round is the one you committed to before paying and no other round can be substituted; example_only appears only in catalog examples.

target_round.description: Echoes the round actually selected for this result; in server_next mode this is the server-chosen round, not the 0 you sent.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
